steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: A power supply converts AC mains to a stable DC voltage through transformer, rectifier, smoothing and regulation stages. | Key Fact: A step-down transformer reduces the AC mains voltage to a lower AC voltage suitable for the circuit. | Key Fact: Half-wave rectification uses a single diode and only rectifies one half of the AC cycle, giving 50% efficiency. | Key Fact: Full-wave rectification using a bridge rectifier uses four diodes and rectifies both halves of the AC cycle.
